project_type: Full-stack TypeScript monorepo (npm workspaces): React+Vite frontend (JA/EN i18n), AWS Lambda backend, DynamoDB, Amazon Bedrock chat, AWS CDK infra. Digimon-style monster raising game. This task is GitHub issue #30: rebalance the two-column wide-screen (>=760px) layout so the right column is no longer short with a large empty gap at the bottom, while preserving the #19 single-column (<760px) stacking order.

key_patterns: App layout in packages/frontend/src/App.tsx: <main className="game-grid"> has TWO children: LEFT <div className="stage-area"> = .sprite-wrap (sprite + #11 SpeechBubble + 💤/💢/🍖 badges + #10 care-fx overlay) then <ChatPanel> then <StatsPanel>. RIGHT <div className="controls-area"> = <CarePanel> then <BattlePanel>. On wide screens (>=760px) the LEFT column (sprite+chat+stats) is tall and RIGHT (care+battle) is short, leaving a large empty bottom-right gap - THE PROBLEM. Styles in packages/frontend/src/styles.css: `.game-grid` is `grid-template-columns:1fr` (single column) and becomes `1fr 1fr` with `align-items:start` at `@media (min-width:760px)`. `.stage-area` and `.controls-area` are each `display:grid; gap:16px`. The #19 responsive contract: below 760px everything stacks single-column in order sprite -> chat -> stats -> care -> battle; at >=760px two columns. MUST preserve this narrow order and the two-column wide behavior.
relevant_files: packages/frontend/src/App.tsx (the .game-grid with .stage-area and .controls-area children; where StatsPanel/CarePanel/BattlePanel are mounted)
packages/frontend/src/styles.css (.game-grid, .stage-area, .controls-area media query at min-width:760px; the place to rebalance columns and/or set CSS order for the narrow stacking)
